definitions.explanation: Steamed rice that has been inoculated with koji mold (Aspergillus oryzae), used as a fermentation starter in making sake, miso, soy sauce, and other traditional Japanese foods.

examples.japanese: {米麹|こめこうじ}で{甘酒|あまざけ}を{作|つく}る。
examples.english: I make amazake with rice koji.

examples.japanese: この{味噌|みそ}は{米麹|こめこうじ}を{使|つか}っている。
{米麹|こめこうじ}は{日本|にほん}の{発酵食品|はっこうしょくひん}に{欠|か}かせない{材料|ざいりょう}だ。
examples.english: Rice koji is an indispensable ingredient in Japanese fermented foods.

notes:
Composed of {米|こめ} (rice) + {麹|こうじ} (koji mold). Rice koji is the foundation of many traditional Japanese fermented products and is sometimes called Japan's "national mold."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {味噌|みそ}: miso paste
- {醤油|しょうゆ}: soy sauce
- {日本酒|にほんしゅ}: sake
- {甘酒|あまざけ}: sweet fermented rice drink
- {塩麹|しおこうじ}: salt koji (seasoning)
- {味醂|みりん}: mirin (sweet rice wine)
- {米麹|こめこうじ}で{作|つく}る: to make with rice koji
- {米麹|こめこうじ}を{使|つか}った: made using rice koji
- {手作|てづく}り{米麹|こめこうじ}: homemade rice koji

RELATED WORDS:
- {麦麹|むぎこうじ}: barley koji — used for mugi miso and shochu
- {豆麹|まめこうじ}: soybean koji — used for hatcho miso
- {麹菌|こうじきん}: koji mold (Aspergillus oryzae)
